main.marketNotes:
Example notes. SAR is pegged at 3.75, so USD holdings carry little currency risk.
AI capex guidance from hyperscalers drives APP, MSFT, APLD and CRWV sentiment together.
Defense budgets matter for PL and VOYG.

thesis.summary: Geospatial intelligence + defense growth + recurring satellite data. Planet owns the largest daily Earth-imaging archive, and defense and civil government demand is turning it into a recurring data platform.
thesis.whyOwn: Geospatial intelligence + defense + proprietary Earth data
thesis.expEarnGrowth: FCF positive by FY2027, expanding after
thesis.catalysts: Pelican constellation deployment; large defense contracts; adjusted EBITDA profitability
thesis.expValuation: About 6x forward sales now; 4x at maturity is fine if FCF margins reach 20%
thesis.bull: $110: the default geospatial data layer for allied defense
thesis.base: $70: 25% revenue CAGR and a 20% FCF margin by year 5
thesis.bear: $8: Pelican delays, dilution and budget cuts
thesis.expectedReturn: About 33% a year over 5 years in the base case
thesis.wrongReason: Government budgets are lumpy, and a competitor or in-house defense capability could commoditise imagery.
thesis.sellReason: Revenue growth below 20%, Pelican program failure, or defense contracts not renewed.
thesis.intendedSell: Review at $35; hold longer if the platform thesis is still compounding.

plan.sellIfText: Revenue growth <20% OR major defense thesis deterioration

conditions.label: Add below $14 if revenue estimates are unchanged

thesis.summary: AI-driven ad engine (AXON) compounding at high incremental margins, with e-commerce advertisers extending growth beyond mobile gaming.
thesis.whyOwn: AI ad engine / e-commerce expansion / high-margin FCF
thesis.expEarnGrowth: EPS growing faster than revenue on operating leverage
thesis.catalysts: E-commerce self-serve launch; S&P 500 inclusion; buybacks
thesis.bull: $1,200: e-commerce becomes as large as gaming
thesis.bear: $180: ad-tech regulation or a platform policy change
thesis.wrongReason: Platform dependence on app stores; regulatory scrutiny of ad targeting.
thesis.sellReason: Revenue growth below 20%, or valuation above 40x forward FCF without estimate upgrades.

conditions.label: Reduce if valuation exceeds 40x forward FCF
APP reaches $500 without corresponding earnings upgrades

thesis.summary: Commercial space station (Starlab) plus defense technology, with a growing contracted backlog that gives revenue visibility.
thesis.catalysts: Starlab milestones; NASA commercial LEO awards; defense contract wins
thesis.base: $80 if Starlab is funded and backlog converts
thesis.bear: $10 if Starlab slips and backlog shrinks
thesis.wrongReason: NASA budget cuts or Starlab delays could hollow out the backlog.

conditions.label: VOYG backlog falls by more than 20%

thesis.summary: Azure plus Copilot monetise AI across the largest enterprise installed base; durable double-digit earnings growth with low risk.
thesis.wrongReason: AI capex does not earn its cost of capital.
thesis.sellReason: Azure growth below 15% for two quarters.

thesis.summary: Sharia-compliant core exposure to US large caps; the default home for monthly contributions when no single stock meets its buy conditions.
thesis.whyOwn: Core index exposure / default for new money

APLD.whyWant: AI data-center infrastructure; power-constrained locations; long-duration hyperscaler contracts; potential NOI growth
APLD.thesis: Owns powered land and is signing 15-year leases with investment-grade hyperscalers; NOI could compound as capacity comes online.
APLD.whyNotYet: Valuation; debt; construction execution; waiting for a better margin of safety

CRWV.whyWant: GPU cloud capacity leader with contracted backlog from hyperscalers and AI labs
CRWV.whyNotYet: Customer concentration; capex funded by debt

NVDA.whyWant: AI accelerator platform plus the CUDA software moat
NVDA.whyNotYet: Already have AI exposure through APP and MSFT; waiting for a pullback

ASTS.whyWant: Direct-to-cell satellite broadband with carrier partners

ex-t4.note: Core compounder at a fair price

notes.text: Q2: revenue +31% YoY, record backlog, Pelican on schedule. ATM dilution higher than expected.

Q2: backlog down 24% after a NASA award was deferred; FY guidance cut.
